}}'''Rafal Edward Dunin-Borkowski''' [[HonFRMS]] (born 3 August 1969) is a British experimental [[physicist]].  He is currently co-director of the [[Ernst Ruska-Centre|Ernst Ruska-Centre for Microscopy and Spectroscopy with Electrons (ER-C)]] in [[Forschungszentrum Jülich]] and professor of experimental physics in [[RWTH Aachen University]].

==Education==
Rafal Dunin-Borkowski was educated at the [[University of Cambridge]] where he was awarded a [[PhD]] in 1994 for research into [[semiconductor]]s.

==Research==
His research involves the development of quantitative techniques in [[electron microscopy]] and has recently focused on the use of off-axis [[electron holography]] to study magnetic and electrostatic fields in [[Nanoscopic scale|nanoscale]] materials, thin films and devices.

==Awards and honours==
* Honorary Fellow of the [[Royal Microscopical Society]] 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.rms.org.uk/resource/rafal-e-dunin-borkowski-awarded-rms-honorary-fellowship.html | title = Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski awarded RMS Honorary Fellowship}}</ref>
* [[European Research Council]] Synergy Grant 2019, jointly with [[:de:Stefan Blügel|S Blügel]], M Kläui and [[Theo Rasing|T Rasing]].<ref>{{Cite news|title= ERC Synergy Grant: 12 million euros for research into "magic" 3D nanostructures|url= https://www.fz-juelich.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/UK/EN/2019/2019-10-11-er-c-synergy-grant-en.html?nn=721278}}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Microscopy Society of America]] 2015.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.microscopy.org/awards/listoffellows.cfm |title=List of MSA Fellows }}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* [[European Research Council]] Advanced Grant 2012.<ref>{{Cite news|title= Prestigious European Award for Jülich-Aachen Professor Rafal Dunin-Borkowski|url= https://www.rwth-aachen.de/go/id/dfnw?lidx=1}}</ref>
* [[:de:Ernst-Ruska-Preis|Ernst Ruska Prize]] 2009, jointly with [[Martha R. McCartney|M R McCartney]] and T Kasama.<ref>{{Cite news|title= Ernst Ruska Prize of the German Society for Electron Microscopy|url= http://www.dge-homepage.de/erp_e.html}}</ref>
* [[Royal Society University Research Fellowship]] 2000.<ref>{{Cite news|title= Curriculum Vitae of Prof. Dr. Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski|url= https://www.fz-juelich.de/profile/dunin-borkowski_r}}</ref>
* Several awards for Science as Art.<ref>{{Cite news|title= BBC – Manchester – In pictures – Visions of Science|url= http://www.bbc.co.uk/manchester/content/image_galleries/visions_of_science_exhibition_gallery.shtml?6}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title= Telegraph newspaper online – Stunning photos of beasts and beauty|url= https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/3334354/Stunning-photos-of-beasts-and-beauty.html | work=The Daily Telegraph | location=London | first=David | last=Derbyshire | date=2004-10-06 | access-date=2010-05-22}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title= Royal Microscopical Society - Previous scientific imaging competition winners|url= https://www.rms.org.uk/discover-engage/competitions-awards/rms-scientific-imaging-competition/previous-imaging-competition.html|archive-date= 9 May 2021|access-date= 23 May 2020|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20210509073238/https://www.rms.org.uk/discover-engage/competitions-awards/rms-scientific-imaging-competition/previous-imaging-competition.html}}</ref>
